definition: wf_photo_repair_queue status=open failure_reason=source-unavailable: the live card-render probe (photo-monitor.mjs) saw the card fall back to the branded placeholder (lib/imageState.js imageDisplayState() -> 'fallback', i.e. no usable src or a load error) for a place whose identity is not in question

wf_photo_repair_queue status=open failure_reason=no-source AND starved=true (wf_inventory.photo_ref IS NULL AND wf_place_photo.status='rejected'): Commons/Wikipedia has no identity-verified photo and Google has not been asked (spend-gated), so no legitimate source is currently available

the 528 open/source-unavailable rows above are ALL satisfiable_by=528 in wf_photo_queue_census, i.e. wf_inventory.photo_ref or an active wf_place_photo already exists for every one of them right now -- the repair-queue detection was never reconciled against the current photo state. Root cause: app/api/cron/place-photos free-lane recovery (already live pre-audit) wrote a usable photo but nothing closed the matching wf_photo_repair_queue row, so job-watch kept counting an already-fixed card as a placeholder

bucket_label: rate-limit or provider failure (masked by a code bug)
definition: lib/commonsPhotos.js's new generic-Wikipedia city-proof gate (added by the still-open fix/commons-generic-wiki-photo-identity-20260922 branch) referenced the undefined bare identifier `pageprops` instead of `page.pageprops`, throwing a ReferenceError on every coordinate-less <=2-token Wikipedia match. Any repair-queue candidate that hit this branch was recorded as a failure/rejection instead of being resolved or honestly falling through to direct Commons verification. Exact count masked by the bug (cannot be recovered retroactively); fixed 2026-09-23 in commit on fix/commons-generic-wiki-photo-identity-20260922 before merge

production case already caught and quarantined before this audit: Wayfind's generic 'Wishing well' place had inherited a Wikipedia lead image of Fleetwood UK via pageview-identity matching that was looser than photo identity requires. wf_place_photo row for this place is status=rejected, source=wikimedia, verified_at 2026-09-22T11:14:16Z (quarantined). PR #1409 (merged) adds the general guard (a coordinate-less, <=2-token Wikipedia match must prove the Wayfind city in title/shortdesc/extract/categories, else falls through to the stricter direct-Commons file verifier) so this class cannot recur silently

bucket_label: existing Wayfind photo available but not wired to the card
definition: wf_inventory rows with photo_ref IS NULL (and not excluded) that already have an active wf_place_photo (status='active') row -- i.e. Wayfind already recovered/owns a usable photo but wf_inventory.photo_ref was never backfilled from it. Small population; not a systemic wiring bug (lib/freePhoto.js / kit.js's FallbackImg already prefer the vault image when present per scripts/test-photo-vault-wiring.mjs Section A)
